B81C.fTerm:
PROCESSES OR APPARATUS SPECIALLY ADAPTED FOR THE MANUFACTURE OR TREATMENT OF MICROSTRUCTURAL DEVICES OR SYSTEMS (making microcapsules or microballoons B01J 13/02; processes or apparatus specially adapted for the manufacture or treatment of piezoelectric, electrostrictive or magnetostrictive elements per se H10N 30/01)[7]

Note(s)

  • This subclass does not cover:[7]
    • processes or apparatus for the manufacture or treatment of purely electrical or electronic devices, which are covered by section H, e.g. subclass H10P;
    • processes or apparatus involving the manipulation of single atoms or molecules, which are covered by group B82B 3/00.

B81C1/00\\.ja: 基層中または基層上での装置またはシステムの製造または処理（Ｂ８１Ｃ３／００が優先）［７］
B81C1/00\\.en: Manufacture or treatment of devices or systems in or on a substrate (B81C 3/00 takes precedence) [7]

B81C3/00\\.ja: 個別に処理された構成部品からの，装置またはシステムの組立［７］
B81C3/00\\.en: Assembling of devices or systems from individually processed components [7]

B81C99/00\\.ja: このサブクラスの他のグループに分類されない主題事項［２０１０．０１］
B81C99/00\\.en: Subject matter not provided for in other groups of this subclass [2010.01]
